name: Agri_LLaVA_VQA_Bench
description: A visual question answering benchmark focused on agricultural images and tasks; it measures a model's ability to answer free-form and domain-specific questions about crops, plants, and farm scenes. The suite evaluates visual-language understanding in the agriculture domain, emphasizing accurate, context-aware answers to practical farming questions. It is intended to test multimodal models' applicability to agricultural scenarios.
reputation: A niche, domain-specific VQA benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing adoption in agricultural multimodal research.
